messages:
Nina K.: Heads up 1: customer asks during EBC: how do we compensate for involuntary preemption on Dedicated? We need a short proposal by Monday.
Ethan W.: Quick proposal: two-tier compensation: involuntary preempt during pilot -> 100% burst token refund; GA -> 50% refund + credit to next invoice. keeps customers happy while nudging better provisioning.
Priya S.: Concern: 100% refund in pilot could skew usage patterns. customers may purposely spike to test refunds. can we gate refunds to "confirmed preempt events" only (eviction_reason==preempt && ops-ack=true)?
Marco G.: Agree on gating. also add a cap per tenant per month (e.g., 10% of committed tokens) to limit abuse.
Legal - Hana: Contract angle: refunds must be in writing in SLA appendix. also need to add opt-out upgrade clause if a customer wants zero-preempt guarantees.
OpsBot: Note: existing telemetry emits eviction_reason as a freeform string. recommend standardizing to enum {soft_preempt, hard_preempt, regional_failover}.
Nina K.: Good catch. Add telemetry standardization to launch tasks.
Ethan W.: Implementation engineering notes: billing pipeline team needs an idempotent event from runtime: preempt_event {tenant_id, spilled_tokens, timestamp, preempt_type, correlation_id}. Billing will map spilled_tokens -> credits.
Priya S.: Metric ask: fairness score per pool = sum(spilled_tokens_per_tenant_weighted_by_commitment) / pool_capacity. if fairness_score > threshold => trigger admission-slowdown.
Marco G.: Nice metric. also need an observable SLA metric: involuntary_preempt_rate per tenant (preempts / active_sessions). target <0.5% for GA.
Nina K.: Pilot criteria (draft): 1) enum eviction reasons implemented + emitted events 2) billing prototype that ingests preempt_event and issues provisional credits 3) opt-out purchase flow sketched with pricing delta 4) fairness metric + dashboard 5) 2 pilot customers and 1 non-pilot control customer.
Ethan W.: Timeline suggestion: MR for runtime events + enum in 1 sprint, billing prototype in parallel, dashboard in sprint 2. pilot kickoff sprint 3. overall ~7 weeks.
Priya S.: Ops requirement: preempt alert must auto-create incident in ops tracker when preempt_rate spikes for any tenant >0.2% within 15m.
Marco G.: Edge case: multi-tenant preempt where routing spills to fallback region. Do we count spilled_tokens as preempt if fallback served traffic successfully? I think only when requests were actually dropped or delayed beyond SLA.
Legal - Hana: We'll need clear language: "involuntary preempt" = requests dropped or failed due to placement/eviction, not successful fallback. define in SLA appendix.
Nina K.: Action items: @Ethan W to draft event schema and open runtime PR (due Wed), @Priya S to prototype fairness metric and dashboard query (due Thu), @Marco G to work with billing on ingestion contract (due Fri), @Hana to draft SLA appendix text (due next Tue).
Ethan W.: Will also include a proof-of-concept script to simulate preempt events and validate billing idempotency.
Priya S.: For the opt-out product path: flag in purchase flow + higher commit price. need product page copy. I'll draft the copy for pilot customers.
Nina K.: OK. If no major objections, we'll present this proposal in Monday EBC prep + include numbers for pricing delta for opt-out. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
